types.name: layout.v1.ChartIndicator
types.doc: ChartIndicator stores one configured technical indicator.

fields.name: indicator_type
fields.doc: Indicator type, such as "RSI", "MACD", or "BB".

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Serialized indicator parameters understood by the chart client.

types.name: layout.v1.ChartStyle
types.doc: ChartStyle stores visual chart style settings.

fields.name: style_bytes
fields.doc: Serialized style settings understood by the chart client.

types.name: layout.v1.ChartWidgetConfig
types.doc: Chart widget config (stored in LayoutWidget.widget_config when widget_type == CHART).

fields.name: engine_symbol_id
fields.doc: Engine symbol identifier for the chart market.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Candle timeframe, such as "1m", "5m", "1h", or "1d".

fields.name: indicators
fields.doc: Indicators configured for this chart.

fields.name: style
fields.doc: Visual style options for this chart.

fields.name: layer_overrides
fields.doc:
Optional: per-widget layer visibility overrides.
 If empty, use layer subscriptions defaults for this market.

fields.name: follow_latest
fields.doc: When true, chart follows the latest candle/price (UI behavior).

types.name: layout.v1.CreateLayoutShareLinkRequest
types.doc: CreateLayoutShareLinkRequest creates a share token for one saved layout.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.doc: Saved layout identifier to share.

fields.name: expires_at_ms
fields.doc: Expiration time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC); 0 means the link does not expire.

types.name: layout.v1.CreateLayoutShareLinkResponse
types.doc: CreateLayoutShareLinkResponse returns the minted share token and target snapshot.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token that can resolve the layout snapshot.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the shared template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier created or reused for this layout.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable template version captured by this share link.

types.name: layout.v1.DeleteLayoutRequest
types.doc: DeleteLayoutRequest deletes one saved layout owned by the authenticated caller.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.doc: Layout identifier to delete.

types.name: layout.v1.DeleteLayoutResponse
types.doc: DeleteLayoutResponse is empty when the layout was deleted.

types.name: layout.v1.DeleteLayoutTemplateSubscriptionRequest
types.doc: DeleteLayoutTemplateSubscriptionRequest deletes one followed template.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier to unfollow.

types.name: layout.v1.DeleteLayoutTemplateSubscriptionResponse
types.doc: DeleteLayoutTemplateSubscriptionResponse is empty when the subscription was deleted.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutRequest
types.doc: GetLayoutRequest fetches one saved layout by ID.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.doc: Layout identifier to fetch.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutResponse
types.doc: GetLayoutResponse contains one saved layout.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Saved layout matching the requested id.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutTemplateVersionRequest
types.doc: GetLayoutTemplateVersionRequest fetches one immutable template version.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable version number to fetch.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutTemplateVersionResponse
types.doc: GetLayoutTemplateVersionResponse returns one immutable template snapshot.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Layout snapshot captured for the requested version.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable version number returned.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutsRequest
types.doc: GetLayoutsRequest lists saved layouts for the authenticated caller.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of layouts to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum
 is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated caller and newest-updated sort order.

types.name: layout.v1.GetLayoutsResponse
types.doc: GetLayoutsResponse contains the caller's saved layouts.

fields.name: layouts
fields.doc: Saved layouts for the caller, returned newest-updated first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: layout.v1.LayerVisibilityOverride
types.doc: LayerVisibilityOverride sets per-chart visibility for one chart layer.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Chart layer whose visibility is overridden.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: True when the layer should be visible in this chart.

types.name: layout.v1.Layout
types.doc: Layout is a saved editor workspace owned by one viewer.

fields.name: viewer_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the saved layout.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.doc: Layout identifier unique within the viewer's saved layouts.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable layout name.

fields.name: is_default
fields.doc: True when this is the viewer's default layout.

fields.name: dockview_state
fields.doc: Serialized editor panel arrangement snapshot.

fields.name: widgets
fields.doc: Widgets contained in the layout.

fields.name: updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Last update time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: layout.v1.LayoutTemplate
types.doc: LayoutTemplate contains discovery metadata for a versioned layout template.

fields.name: template
fields.doc: Template identifier.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Public display title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Public description shown with the template.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Public tags used for grouping or filtering.

fields.name: is_listed
fields.doc: True when the template appears in discovery listings.

fields.name: latest_version
fields.doc: Latest immutable version number for this template.

fields.name: published_at_ms
fields.doc: Initial publication time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Last metadata update time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: layout.v1.LayoutTemplateRef
types.doc: LayoutTemplateRef identifies a published layout template.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier unique within the owner.

types.name: layout.v1.LayoutTemplateSubscription
types.doc: LayoutTemplateSubscription describes one template followed by a viewer.

fields.name: viewer_id
fields.doc: Viewer that follows the template.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Followed template identifier.

fields.name: track_latest
fields.doc: True when the subscription follows the latest version automatically.

fields.name: pinned_version
fields.doc: Version followed when track_latest is false.

fields.name: updated_at_ms
fields.doc: Subscription update time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: layout.v1.LayoutTemplateVersionInfo
types.doc: LayoutTemplateVersionInfo contains metadata for one immutable template version.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable template version number.

fields.name: changelog
fields.doc: Optional release notes for this version.

fields.name: created_at_ms
fields.doc: Version creation time in milliseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: layout.v1.LayoutWidget
types.doc: LayoutWidget stores one widget instance and its widget-specific configuration.

fields.name: widget_id
fields.doc: Stable widget identifier within the layout, such as "chart-1".

fields.name: widget_type
fields.doc: Widget kind that determines how widget_config is decoded.

fields.name: widget_config
fields.doc: Serialized widget configuration bytes for the selected widget_type.

types.name: layout.v1.ListLayoutTemplateVersionsRequest
types.doc: ListLayoutTemplateVersionsRequest lists immutable versions for one template.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of versions to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum
 is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to owner, template, and newest-version sort order.

types.name: layout.v1.ListLayoutTemplateVersionsResponse
types.doc: ListLayoutTemplateVersionsResponse contains version metadata for a template.

fields.name: versions
fields.doc: Template versions, returned newest version first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: layout.v1.ListMyLayoutTemplateSubscriptionsRequest
types.doc: ListMyLayoutTemplateSubscriptionsRequest lists templates followed by the authenticated caller.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of subscriptions to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted;
 maximum is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated caller and newest-updated sort order.

types.name: layout.v1.ListMyLayoutTemplateSubscriptionsResponse
types.doc: ListMyLayoutTemplateSubscriptionsResponse contains the caller's followed templates.

fields.name: subscriptions
fields.doc: Followed templates for the caller, returned newest-updated first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: layout.v1.ListOwnerPublishedLayoutsRequest
types.doc: ListOwnerPublishedLayoutsRequest lists published templates owned by one viewer.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Owner whose published layouts should be listed.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of templates to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted;
 maximum is 500.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to owner and newest-published sort order.

types.name: layout.v1.ListOwnerPublishedLayoutsResponse
types.doc: ListOwnerPublishedLayoutsResponse contains one page of published templates.

fields.name: templates
fields.doc: Published templates for the owner, returned newest-published first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: layout.v1.PublishLayoutRequest
types.doc: PublishLayoutRequest creates a new immutable template version from a saved layout.

fields.name: layout_id
fields.doc: Saved layout identifier to publish.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Public display title.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Public description shown with the template.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Public tags used for grouping or filtering.

fields.name: is_listed
fields.doc: True when the template should appear in discovery listings.

fields.name: changelog
fields.doc: Optional release notes for the new immutable version.

types.name: layout.v1.PublishLayoutResponse
types.doc: PublishLayoutResponse returns the published template and version number.

fields.name: template
fields.doc: Published template metadata after the update.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable version number created by this publish operation.

types.name: layout.v1.ResolveLayoutShareTokenRequest
types.doc: Resolve a share token to a layout snapshot (template). No auth required.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token from a layout share link.

types.name: layout.v1.ResolveLayoutShareTokenResponse
types.doc: ResolveLayoutShareTokenResponse returns the immutable layout snapshot for a share token.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Shared layout snapshot.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the shared template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier referenced by the share token.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Immutable template version referenced by the share token.

types.name: layout.v1.RevokeLayoutShareLinkRequest
types.doc: RevokeLayoutShareLinkRequest revokes one previously minted share token.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Opaque share token to revoke.

types.name: layout.v1.RevokeLayoutShareLinkResponse
types.doc: RevokeLayoutShareLinkResponse is empty when the token was revoked.

types.name: layout.v1.SetLayoutTemplateSubscriptionRequest
types.doc: SetLayoutTemplateSubscriptionRequest follows a template by tracking latest or pinning a version.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.doc: Viewer that owns the template.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Template identifier to follow.

fields.name: track_latest
fields.doc: True to follow the latest version automatically.

fields.name: pinned_version
fields.doc: Version to follow when track_latest is false.

types.name: layout.v1.SetLayoutTemplateSubscriptionResponse
types.doc: SetLayoutTemplateSubscriptionResponse is empty when the subscription was saved.

types.name: layout.v1.UnpublishLayoutRequest
types.doc: UnpublishLayoutRequest removes a template from discovery listings.

fields.name: template_id
fields.doc: Removes the template from discovery (unlisted). Versions and share links remain.

types.name: layout.v1.UnpublishLayoutResponse
types.doc: UnpublishLayoutResponse is empty when the template was removed from discovery.

types.name: layout.v1.UpsertLayoutRequest
types.doc: UpsertLayoutRequest creates or updates a saved layout for the authenticated caller.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Layout payload to save.

types.name: layout.v1.UpsertLayoutResponse
types.doc: UpsertLayoutResponse returns the saved layout.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Saved layout after server-side ownership and timestamp handling.

types.name: layout.v1.WidgetType
types.doc: WidgetType identifies the kind of editor widget stored in a layout.
